note: Not converter-produced. Silk has no JS component library; this layout was authored off-script from 12 of the 13 static HTML+CSS mockups in silk-ds/. The thirteenth, screens/interactive.html, was added after the first sync and has no card, so it is in sourceHashes with no renderHashes entry. Any resync driver keying on shape==storybook|package will not match this envelope and will correctly re-verify everything. See .design-sync/NOTES.md.
keyRecipe: sha256[:12] per file; sourceHashes over silk-ds/**, renderHashes over each uploaded card, bundleSha12 over _ds_bundle.css alone, styleSha over styles.css + tokens/color.css + tokens/type.css + _ds_bundle.css concatenated in that order with no separator
